required_description: INTEGRATION KIT, POWER BRUSH CYGNUS GAUGE
notes: DT40 VAC & MAG lists 2604 as INTEGRATION KIT, POWER BRUSH CYGNUS GAUGE and notes REQUIRES 2601. This is a manufacturer price-book dependency, not a fabricated technical answer. 7851-PHOTON is a different part.
Required because DT40 notes on 2604 say REQUIRES 2601. 9701-MAG-4K package notes do not list 2601. Historical MAG 8194 has no independent 2601 sales line. Do not treat 360,000 JPY as including 2601.
